competitiveAlternatives: A regular techno or house night at a Bengaluru club (pets stay home)
A daytime pet social or pet yoga event (no real music)
uniqueAttributes: Pet-friendly underground music nights: CCD x Social at Social BLR
Music-first curation from a producer/DJ founder (Merman)
A platform behind the nights: artist directory, gig scraper across Indian ticketing sites, fan XP, CCD School
Distinct identity: brutalist isometric cat world, top-hat cat mascot
value: A real night out without leaving your pet behind
Good underground music in a crowd that's there for it
For artists: a way to get found and booked
positioning.bestFitCustomer: Bengaluru gig-goers aged 21-35 who love electronic and underground music and own (or love) pets, and want nights out that don't mean choosing between the two.
positioning.statement: Cats Can Dance runs Bengaluru's pet-friendly underground music nights: proper sets, a crowd that's there for the music, and your dog's welcome too.

motivations.name: Don't leave them home
motivations.insight: Pet owners skip nights out or feel guilty leaving pets alone; every music night in town is pet-free
proofPoints: CCD x Social nights are pet-friendly by design

motivations.name: The music is the point
motivations.insight: Underground fans pick nights on lineup and sound, not venue luxury
proofPoints: Lineups of local and touring artists

motivations.name: Your kind of crowd
motivations.insight: People want a room of people who care about music (and dogs), not a commercial club crowd

motivations.name: Limited night, limited tickets
motivations.insight: Early-bird and limited capacity drive action, as competitors show with early-bird pricing and India debuts

motivations.name: Join the cat world
motivations.insight: A strong visual world and mascot gives people something to belong to and share

motivations.name: Get booked, get better
motivations.insight: Local and touring producers want gigs and discovery; CCD gives them profiles and learning

offers.name: Early-bird with your pet
offers.hypothesis: A small early-bird tier with a 'bring your pet' line sells the first third of tickets faster than a single price
offers.structure: Limited early-bird tier, then regular; pet entry free with a ticket (confirm venue rules)
offers.risk: Venue pet limits; need clear pet rules on the page

offers.name: Crew pass
offers.hypothesis: Groups of 3-4 book together and bring friends who wouldn't come alone

offers.name: Claim your artist profile
offers.hypothesis: Artists claiming profiles share them and bring their fans to the platform and nights
offers.structure: Free profile claim with a shareable card

channels.channel: Meta ads (Instagram first), broad targeting, 15+ distinct concepts
channels.cadence: From announcement to event day, refresh weekly

channels.channel: Boosts of best organic posts from the 150k page and CCD account
channels.kpi: Cost per profile visit and ticket

channels.channel: Ticketing listings (District, Insider, HighApe, SortMyScene) in music and pet categories
Event pages with 'how did you hear about us' + WhatsApp
Citable pages: Bengaluru underground gig guide + pet-friendly nights page

primaryMetric.name: Tickets sold per night and cost per ticket
primaryMetric.target: Sell out each night; set the cost-per-ticket target after the first 50 paid sales

tests.hypothesis: 'Don't leave them home' beats 'the music is the point' on cost per ticket
tests.killRule: Pause a motivation at 2x the best cost after meaningful spend

tests.hypothesis: Founder talking-head video beats designed statics
tests.killRule: Drop the losing format for the next night

tests.hypothesis: Listing in pet categories on ticketing apps adds sales from non-music audiences
tests.metric: Tickets from pet listings and HDYHAU answers
tests.killRule: Stop pet-category listings if under 5% of tickets over two nights

risks: Venue rules on pets and noise; pet welfare must be visibly handled
Founder notes CCD is barely doing events right now; the series needs a fixed calendar to build momentum
Small budgets limit how fast Meta learns
Follower base of the CCD account is small; the 150k founder page must hand off to CCD
